title: Rendering Engine
definition: The rendering engine (e.g., Blink for Chrome, WebKit for Safari) is responsible for taking HTML, CSS, and JavaScript and turning it into the pixels drawn on your screen.
simpleExplanation: The rendering engine is the factory that reads your code blueprints and actually builds the visible house on the screen.
